item.title: KarvA chaut, anasUyA vratam
item.description:
Source: TW

“Why do only women fast for their husbands?”

The statement (behind this question) is not true. In Sanātana Dharma, there are certain vratas to be performed by the husband for the well-being of his wife or jointly by the couple for each other’s well-being. Some references from the shastras are given below.

Aśūnya-śayana-vrata: To be performed by the husband so that he may never be separated from his wife. The wife may also perform it. The performer may eat only one meal devoid of oil or salt per day for four months starting on the second day of Śrāvaṇa. At the end of the observance, certain gifts of food items are given to the wife.
